summary: Positions 150-299: Haiku 63 photo, 78 skip (incl. dup 150, 180, 299), 9 unsure. Of 63 photo: 48 keep_ok (4 of them with a field fix: longmire-buildings by, cafe-era year and features, gary-bathing-beach-aquatorium type; 4 with a better first photo: bruder-klaus-kirche, villa-patocka, olveston-historic-home, edward-p-evans-hall), 15 keep_wrong (5 empty leads: volksbuhne, carpenter-theatre, edificio-urumea, uris-hall, hoffman-hall; 2 pre-1900: paradiso-amsterdam, philadelphia-history-museum; 8 ordinary or revival: palm-springs-convention-center, scranton-cultural-center, louise-freer-hall, kitchi-gammi-club, st-willibald, neues-rathaus, royce-hall, helsinki-stock-exchange-building). 2 flagged ordinary among the kept (khovo-lar housing, las-palmas former workshop) = about 4%. 5 rescued: einsteinhaus-caputh (high confidence), emmaus-church-vols (good), kauniainen-church, butte-aux-cailles-swimming-pool, villa-bonnier (lower confidence). Not rescued: all empty leads (Suva House, Central Signal Box, St. Helena Bonn, Magnolia Library, Gartenbad, Rotonda House, Haus Ungers, Felder house, Braem Pavilion, Reformed Church Reinach and others), buildings with no usable photo (Balmelli, Esherick, Sommerfeld House (also destroyed), Marshcourt, Casa Vilaro, WUWA 36), pre-1900 Raio Palace and Pfingstberg Belvedere (Persius died 1845; built 1847-63), and church skips with lead giving only parish/listing (St. Nikolaus and St. Karl Borromaus Munich, Maria Hilf, St. Christophorus, St. Martin Meilen, Mikaeli). Generic names kept as Wikidata labels (People's House, Saint Thomas Church, Auferstehungskirche); the caller may want 'Volkshaus Biel', 'Thomaskirche, Basel', 'Auferstehungskirche, Bonn'.
